segments.name: Automotive Electronics Resale Business
products: automotive electronic component equipment and accessories
segments.description: Sources, holds and resells automotive electronics products procured from third-party suppliers, delivering them to customers through the company's own sales channels.
segments.evidence: Our automotive electronics resale business focuses on sourcing, holding, and reselling automotive electronics products.

segments.name: Advertising business
segments.description: The advertising business is the company's second reportable segment, reported beside the automotive electronics resale business it now operates.
segments.evidence: We derive our revenue from two reportable operating segments: (i) Sales of automotive electronic component equipment and accessories, mainly consisting of communication device, power module, etc. and (ii) Advertising business.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company negotiated prices for automotive electronic components it procures from third-party suppliers and resells through its sales channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We procure products from third-party suppliers and resell them to customers through our sales channels.

changes.text: In 2025 the company disposed of substantially all of its legacy business segments in transactions that closed in October 2025.
changes.evidence: In the last quarter of 2025, we disposed of substantially all of our legacy business segments in a series of transactions that closed in October 2025.

changes.text: The auto show business was discontinued, and in 2025 the company operated only an automobile electronics resale business launched that quarter.
changes.evidence: We no longer operate this business segment, and it constitutes discontinued operations.
